headline: Frozen is showing selective strength while pizza-adjacent pressure builds; Real Dough should tighten proof on value, clean ingredients and retailer-ready product data.

items: Market intel feed is current through 2026-08-14 with five daily reports for ISO week 33.

Frozen foods outperformed the broader grocery basket in the latest Circana/210 Analytics read: frozen food units were up 0.2% while total food and beverage units fell 0.9%; frozen snacks rose 3.2% and frozen baked goods rose 3.7%.

Real Dough's clean sourdough positioning fits the week's regulatory and shopper signals: FDA is moving toward mandatory notifications for self-affirmed GRAS ingredients, making simple-ingredient documentation more important.

Hospitality reputation signal remains healthy across the Merriment Social group: Google ratings in data/reviews.json are 4.4 Merriment Social, 4.5 Third Coast Provisions, 4.5 Flourchild Pizza and 4.7 The Loon Room.

Pizza-adjacent competition is widening beyond finished pies: JusRol added 2,900-plus U.S. placements, including Walmart pizza dough expansion to 2,106 Family Size Pizza Crust stores and 476 Snap Pizza Dough stores.
Private-label value pressure is active in frozen pizza-adjacent snacks: Food Lion added mini pizza bagels and pepperoni pizza bites at $1.99-$3.99 price points.
Retail buyers remain under margin and traffic pressure: Supermarket News scored July grocery at 48, with earnings at 40 despite stronger visit trends.

AI and e-commerce readiness moved up the retailer agenda: Kroger reported 19% online sales growth, while grocery AI commentary emphasized complete product metadata for ingredients, allergens, prep time, dietary fit and recipe use cases.

Audit Real Dough retailer/PDP data for AI and e-commerce discovery: sourdough proof, Wisconsin origin, prep time, allergens, ingredient claims, serving occasions and recipe-use language should be complete and machine-readable.
Build a defensible value comparison versus lower-priced private-label pizza snacks and refrigerated pizza dough; do not rely on premium cues alone.
Prepare supplier and ingredient documentation for retailer quality reviews in case FDA GRAS scrutiny raises buyer questions on processing inputs.
Ask agency to focus next creative brief on clean sourdough proof plus practical meal value; there is no current analytics feed in this repo to claim which creative won this week.

agency_brief.what_worked: The strongest defensible story this week is market fit, not campaign performance: frozen is holding up better than the total grocery basket, clean-ingredient scrutiny is rising, and retailers need products that are easy to find, explain and convert online.
agency_brief.what_didnt: No current paid, organic social or content-performance analytics source is wired into this repo, so there is no defensible basis here to identify winning creative, channel efficiency or spend performance for the week.
agency_brief.recommendation: Position Real Dough as premium frozen pizza with proof: real sourdough process, clean ingredients, clear prep convenience, Wisconsin origin and concrete meal value. Make the same claims consistent across retailer PDPs, agency copy and sales materials.
agency_brief.competitive_context: JusRol is scaling pizza dough at Walmart and Wegmans, Food Lion is pushing low-price pizza-adjacent frozen snacks, Crafty Ramen is entering more than 4,000 U.S. shelves, and Sprouts continues expanding around tighter self-distribution. Retailers are still open to differentiated frozen products, but they will expect sharper value rationale and cleaner execution data.

missing: Current paid/social/content analytics source is not wired into this repo; no weekly campaign-performance claims were made.
No current Real Dough sales, velocity, distribution or promo-performance feed is available from the approved sources for this run.
